textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Living in Harmony · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: We bring some animals and plants into our homes, and some start living in our homes on their own. Sometimes we share our home with them happily, but sometimes we do not like them in our home.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: We bring some animals and plants into our homes, and some start living in our homes on their own. Sometimes we share our home with them happily, but sometimes we do not like them in our home.
beats.speakEn: We bring some animals and plants into our homes, and some start living in our homes on their own. Sometimes we share our home with them happily, but sometimes we do not like them in our home.

beats.en: The mango tree was home to birds, squirrels, monkeys and many other animals. A tree can be a house for many living things. Shambhu saw a monkey eating a mango and throwing out the seed.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Living in Harmony · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Plants give us many things. They give us shade, fruits, fresh air, medicine, wood and fibre. Plants also give shelter to animals, and give food to animals.

beats.en: Plants give us many things. They give us shade, fruits, fresh air, medicine, wood and fibre. Plants also give shelter to animals, and give food to animals.
beats.speakEn: Plants give us many things. They give us shade, fruits, fresh air, medicine, wood and fibre. Plants also give shelter to animals, and give food to animals.

beats.en: We give care, protection, food and shelter to animals and plants, and we get many things from them as well. From cows, buffaloes and goats we get milk and loving company.
beats.speakEn: We give care, protection, food and shelter to animals and plants, and we get many things from them as well. From cows, buffaloes and goats we get milk and loving company.

type: Plants give us many things. They give us shade, fruits, fresh air, medicine, wood and fibre.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Living in Harmony · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: Thousands of trees are planted by squirrels by accident. They bury nuts and then forget where they hid them. The buried nuts grow into new trees.
